notes: 0.3.37：本机路径卡平时不再显示——没有告警时这张卡连同它所在分区的标题整块不渲染。0.3.30 起这张卡就把三项根和占位符全列在页面上，可正常机器上路径本来就不该改：它一直占着版面，还容易让人以为「这里要填点什么」。现在只有三种情况才自己出现：上次拉取有配置没写进去（有待确认路径）、仓库里查见根外绝对路径（换机就是死路径）、上次拉取覆盖了本机配置。想主动改路径（换机器、加自选目录）点页面标题行的「本机路径」按钮叫出来，再点一次收起。卡内行为不变：先只读、点「修改」解锁、编辑态每根一个「用探测值」、自选目录可增删、没探测到任何根时强制编辑态。README 中英各补一段，客户端自检新增两条断言（平时不渲染、标题行有展开按钮）。
notesEn: 0.3.37: the Local paths card no longer sits on the page - with no warnings the card and its whole section title are not rendered. Since 0.3.30 it listed all three roots and their placeholders at all times, but on a normal machine the paths are not meant to be edited: it took room and invited people to fill something in. It now appears by itself in exactly three cases: configs skipped during the last pull (paths still to confirm), absolute paths found in the repo outside every root (dead on another machine), and configs the last pull overwrote locally. To edit paths deliberately (new machine, adding a custom root) use the "Local paths" button in the page title row, and click it again to hide. Everything inside the card is unchanged: read-only until Edit, a "Detected" button per root in edit mode, add/remove custom folders, and forced edit mode when nothing was detected. README updated in both languages; two new client assertions (hidden by default, expand button present).
